name: SEO Review
headline: SEO Review: Maximize Search Visibility
short_description: Perform SEO audits on pages to maximize search visibility, internal linking, and ranking potential. Marketing teams use this to identify issues and opportunities for improvement. Connects to CMS platforms and analytics tools to provide actionable insights.
author: ShyftAI

sections.overview:
The SEO Review skill is designed to perform comprehensive SEO audits on web pages, focusing on maximizing search visibility, improving internal linking, and enhancing ranking potential. By leveraging this Claude Code skill, users can systematically evaluate their web content and identify areas for improvement, ensuring that their pages are optimized for search engines. This skill simplifies the audit process, allowing users to quickly pinpoint issues that could hinder their online presence. One of the key benefits of the SEO Review skill is its ability to save time during the optimization process. While the exact time savings are currently unknown, the skill's structured approach enables users to conduct audits in approximately 30 minutes. This efficiency is particularly valuable for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are often pressed for time yet need to ensure their content is competitive in search rankings. By automating the audit process, teams can focus their efforts on implementing changes rather than spending excessive time on manual reviews. This skill is ideal for professionals involved in web development, digital marketing, and product management. It supports roles that require a strong understanding of SEO principles and the need to enhance web content performance. For instance, a product manager might use the SEO Review skill to ensure that new product pages are optimized before launch, while a developer could utilize it to refine existing content on a company website. The practical applications are vast, from improving blog posts to optimizing e-commerce product descriptions. Implementation of the SEO Review skill is categorized as intermediate, making it accessible to those with a basic understanding of SEO and web development. Users need to integrate the skill into their existing workflows, which aligns perfectly with AI-first strategies that prioritize automation and efficiency. By incorporating the SEO Review skill into their toolkit, teams can enhance their overall SEO strategy, ensuring that their content not only reaches the intended audience but also performs well in search engine results.
Conduct a thorough SEO audit of a webpage to identify optimization opportunities.
Analyze internal linking structures to enhance site navigation and user experience.
Evaluate keyword usage and suggest improvements for better search rankings.
Generate reports on SEO performance metrics to track progress over time.
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
Conduct an SEO audit for [WEBSITE_URL]. Identify issues related to meta tags, internal linking, keyword optimization, and page speed. Provide actionable recommendations to improve search visibility and ranking potential. Focus on [INDUSTRY] best practices and [COMPANY] goals.
```
